a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (generate to 8, then split) almost certainly gets us both killed, since it needs about 3 rounds. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the random split likely leaves both of us under 4. If you see a fairer way to decide who takes, say so and I'll consider it. If we survive round 1, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said in my opening. I know this breaks our original plan, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve grows for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate too, then take 4 as soon as the reserve can cover it.
